answer: Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the meadow of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. The design leans on per-epoch sampling audit, reset on any identity-link attempt, no identity may audit its own recruit. The harbor lists finished tasks with their hashes, and the opal is where a second reviewer recomputes them. Written in a cause and effect, two sentences register, it stays short. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities.
